candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart creates a group of Marines as combat constructs

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John manifests a squad of Marine constructs to fight with him. This is a tactical/assisted battlefield use of the ring rather than a permanent creation.
candidates.title: Blackest Night Marine squad
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John summons a whole Marine unit that joins the fight against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart fires a sniper-rifle construct into Mogo’s core

claim_citation.quote: John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John builds a precise sniper rifle construct and uses it to deliver the finishing shot that kills Mogo. This is one of his most lethal and technically detailed constructs.
candidates.title: The Mogo sniper shot
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests a sniper rifle, takes aim, and shoots a bullet straight into Mogo’s core.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart’s Xanshi-destruction bubble construct / failed rescue attempt

claim_citation.quote: In Cosmic Odyssey #2, John Stewart and Martian Manhunter find that the planet, Xanshi, has been infected by the Anti-Life Aspect.

candidates.summary: A partial construct-assisted feat: John traps Martian Manhunter in a construct bubble and pushes ahead alone, which leads into the disaster that wipes out Xanshi. This is one of John’s most infamous failures, not a successful save.
candidates.title: Cosmic Odyssey
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John creates a bubble construct around Martian Manhunter, then heads toward the yellow bomb; Xanshi is destroyed and the whole system is lost.

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: John manifests a whole squad of Marine constructs and uses them in battle against the Black Lanterns. Partial/assisted case: the construct is combat-support, not a reality rewrite.
candidates.title: Blackest Night
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John summons a full group of green Marine soldiers, and they fight beside him against the Black Lanterns.

claim_citation.quote: After Kyle's ring cannot purify Mogo, John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: A precision assisted construct: John builds a sniper rifle and uses it to kill the corrupted living planet Mogo. This is one of his most lethal and technically specific constructs.
candidates.title: War of the Green Lanterns / Mogo kill
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John materializes a sniper rifle, takes aim at Mogo’s core, and fires the shot that ends the threat.

claim_citation.quote: The series saw the beginning of John Stewart's brief tenure as a member of the Guardians of the Universe, which is a race of immortal beings who are responsible for the creation of the Green Lantern Corps.

candidates.summary: The most ambitious large-scale construct-related feat in the sourced material: John becomes the human guardian of Mosaic World, the patchwork of transplanted cities. This is a partial/assisted case because Appa Ali Apsa starts the project, but John inherits and sustains it.
candidates.title: Mosaic
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John helps hold together a world made from cities transplanted from multiple planets and becomes its administrator.
